action.prompt:
A file was just saved. Remind the user that Mira enforces Prettier formatting via lint-staged on commit. If this file will be committed, ensure it is formatted:

```bash
bunx prettier --write <file>
# or format everything:
bun run format
```

Prettier config (`.prettierrc`): `semi: false`, `singleQuote: true`, `trailingComma: "all"`, `printWidth: 100`

No action needed if formatting was already applied.
